Title: AKU Faculty, Teaching and Learning Staff among 2017/2018 HEA, UK Fellows
NewsSummary: Congratulations to all the Facutly and Teaching and Learning staff who have recently gained their Fellowships from the Higher Education Academy (HEA) in the United Kingdom (UK)
NewsContent:
The Aga Khan University (AKU) Provost, Dr. Carl Amrhein and the Director, Networks of Quality, Teaching and Learning (QTL) Dr. Tashmin Khamis hereby congratulate Faculty as well as Teaching and Learning (TL_net) Staff who have recently gained their Fellowships from the Higher Education Academy (HEA) in the United Kingdom (UK).

The fellows are as listed below:

*Dr. Tashmin Khamis, Director, Quality, Teaching and Learning (QTL), Office of the Provost, Principal fellow

*Dr. Kulsoom Ghais, Medical College, Pakistan, Senior fellow

*Dr. Faisal Ismail, Medical College, Pakistan, Senior fellow

*Dr. Mary Omingo, TL-net, Office of the Provost, Senior fellow

*Azra Naseem, BDL-net, Office of the Provost & IED, Pakistan 

*Dr. Jacqueline Dias, SONAM, Pakistan, Senior fellow

*Dr. Ayesha Mian, Medical College, Pakistan, Senior fellow

*Dr. Sadia Bhutta, IED, Pakistan, Fellow

*Dr. Naghma Rizvi, SONAM, Pakistan, Fellow

*Zeenar Salim, TL-net, Office of the Provost, Fellow

*Sahreen Chauhan, TL-net, Office of the Provost, Fellow

*Edward Misava, TL-net, Office of the Provost, Associate fellow

Dr. Tashmin Khamis, the Director, QTL also received the award of Principal Fellowship, courtesy HEA, UK. This achievement recognises Dr. Khamis' strategic leadership in enhancing teaching quality at AKU. Dr. Khamis is one of only 800 Principal Fellows of the 94,000 HEA Fellows world-wide and this recognition internationally benchmarks AKU's efforts to strengthen the student learning experience. 

Besides this award, Dr. Khamis has also been appointed to the Quality Advisory Board of HEA, UK. She now joins an international panel of judges for the HEA Global Teaching Excellence Award (for the second year running). 

More information:

HEA's mission is to improve learning outcomes by raising the quality and status of teaching in Higher Education. HEA works with Universities to improve the professional experience of faculty through accreditation of educational development provision and professional recognition of teaching practice through fellowships benchmarked against the Professional Standards Framework(UKPSF) UK.  The UKPSF is the only national framework in the world dedicated to support the development of learning and teaching staff in Higher Education. AKU is the first strategic partner of HEA, UK in the developing world. We look forward to the pioneer HEA Fellows at AKU supporting other faculty to gain Fellowship of the HEA once TL_net gains accreditation of the HEA.
